description: Archival dataset of Autonomous Systems operated by state-owned Internet operators (ACM IMC 2021), with the quote and source URL that confirmed state ownership.
rules: Ownership was verified from June 2019 to November 2020 and is not maintained. Use the data as a baseline for that period.
Read CSV with pandas using keep_default_na=False and na_values=[''], because NA is Namibia's country code.
Edit only data/canonical JSON, then regenerate data/exports with state-owned-ases export.
Evidence is per AS: one org_id can have different quotes or URLs. AS6713 is in both datasets on purpose.
Cite the IMC 2021 paper (doi:10.1145/3487552.3487822). The package is not on PyPI; run the CLI from the repository root.
